chiyoko-player.rng.cracked: entity seed cracked! ready to predict

chiyoko-player.autocrack.failed.timed_ou: auto crack timed out, keep your camera still while it drops
chiyoko-player.autocrack.failed.out_of_d: auto crack failed, %s drops were not enough, drop a few more items yourself to finish
chiyoko-player.autocrack.failed.out_of_j: auto crack ran out of junk blocks, drop a few more items yourself to finish
